source: Static game config (QuestData); English text from the localization table.
notes: task = the game's title with {0} filled by the required amount. Named parameters like {HeroUpgradeLevel} are filled in game from the quest's conditions and are left in place here.
achievement order = group number then level (the game lists groups in enum order).
unconfirmed: Achievement section (tab) comes from the group number ranges, not from a config table: 0-99 Account, 100s Summon, 200s Collection, 300s Gear, 400+ Battle. The tab names shown in game may differ (e.g. 'General', 'Development').
Periodic (daily/weekly) quests have no English text in this export yet.

About 14% of achievement levels (mostly Greater Relic collection, formation upgrades and some boss-stage groups) and ~50 Progress Quest tasks have no title found yet (task is null); their rewards are still listed.
